hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler lending vaults. It intercepts swaps in `beforeSwap`, prices them against its own bonding curve, routes input tokens into Euler vaults and withdraws output from them, returning the full `BeforeSwapDelta` to bypass standard pool math. Concentrated liquidity positions and donations are blocked.
